requirements.title: Portable G-drive workspace and separately managed model and state directories
acceptance: Owner Windows default root is G:\Assistant with repo, models/ollama, data/db, data/history, data/memory, data/identity, data/skills, workspace, logs, backups and cache in separate root-relative directories.
Missing or inaccessible G: produces an explicit error; no fallback to C:. Changing only ASSISTANT_ROOT relocates all application-owned paths without modifying other env variables.
Ollama models use OLLAMA_MODELS bound to effective root before first model pull; restart and path access are checked.
Private state remains outside git; safe consistent SQLite backup and restoration are documented and tested.
requirements.notes: Verified within the first local M1 slice; see evidence and runbook for operation boundaries.

requirements.title: Memory retention and lifecycle policy
acceptance: Classify durable facts/decisions versus temporary caches and archived source records; user can prevent automatic remembering and request record removal.
Retention/compaction never destroys sourced decisions without explicit policy and auditable evidence.
Local indexes are rebuildable from retained canonical records.
requirements.notes: Verified within the first local M1 slice; see evidence and runbook for operation boundaries.
